sent: This is a normal heartbeat. [pause 0.3] The S-A node fires, the signal travels down through the A-V node, and both ventricles squeeze together. [pause 0.45] Now watch what happens in Mobitz type two heart block. [pause 0.35] The atria keep firing on time, but some signals suddenly stop below the A-V node, with no warning. [pause 0.4] Every dropped beat is a missing heartbeat, and it can progress to complete heart block. [pause 0.45] Pads on. [pause 0.35] If unstable, try atropine, but it often fails here. [pause 0.35] Then pace, or start an epinephrine drip. [pause 0.5] Practice it on A-C-L-S med Sim. [pause 0.35] A-C-L-S med dot com. [pause 1.2]
